issue_context.title: Expose IServer.Features to DI
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe the problem.

While adding a new feature to YARP, I had a need to add my new type to DI but my type also required access to a server feature. This didn't work as it seems server features are not added to DI. 

I was able to work around this by adding the feature myself via the IServer object:

```c#
builder.Services.AddSingleton(p => p.GetRequiredService<IServer>().Features.Get<IServerDelegationFeature>());
```

### Describe the solution you'd like

I think it would be nicer if the server features were added to DI directly when created. 

### Additional context

_No response_
comments: I don't know that we'd add all server features, but we should see if we can add IServerDelegationFeature.
Triage: we should see if we can add IServerDelegationFeature as @Tratcher suggested.

review_comments: Isn't this more an implantation detail that a strict requirement?
Yes, I just wanted to make sure they didn't create separate server instances.

Makes sense. I generally error on the side of being too prescriptive in unit tests anyway. There's a limit to this, but if the implementation details change and we can convince ourselves it's non-breaking, we can always just update the tests.
